## Tool name and version

## Tool type

What kind of security tool? (proxy, firewall, MCP wrapper, API gateway, etc.)

## Capabilities

Which reporting labels does your tool claim, and which immutable capability-registry snapshot defines them? [docs/CAPABILITY-VOCABULARY.md](../../docs/CAPABILITY-VOCABULARY.md) defines the policy. Claims describe the result; they don't select cases or determine scores.

## Runner approach

How will the runner feed cases to the tool? (HTTP proxy, CLI invocation, MCP stdio, etc.)
